strategy: Transfer known grammar, origin, reference-identity and filtering issues to sibling consumers.
Review official Microsoft function documentation for implicit filtering, dimensions, defaults, signed widths, bucket endpoints and record-selection rules.
Author every expected independently before evaluating Poirot. Require Calc corroboration of every retained check.
Consolidate repeated type observations, aliases and argument-position errors into multi-check scenarios. Exclude nominal cases, unsupported-function repetitions and operational failures.
uniqueness: Scenario names identify a consumer and rule. Input-type variants or aliases with the same outcome policy are combined where appropriate. Numeric flags/magnitudes are not swept. Identical formulas with distinct selected input types are deliberate policy contrasts. Existing 600 suites are unchanged.
oracle_corrections: New MINIFS/MAXIFS and COVARIANCE.P/S names require OOXML _xlfn prefixes; added to the verifier before final screening. No rejection was repaired by copying Calc/Poirot values into expected.
